conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: Honestly, I’m not doing so great. Just yesterday, I heard a loud noise outside, and it threw me back to some really bad moments. My heart started racing, and I felt like I was just stuck in that place again. It’s tough.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: It's understandable to feel that way. When you heard the noise, what kind of thoughts or feelings did it bring up for you?

conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: When I heard that noise, it felt like everything around me closed in. I started sweating, and my hands shook a bit. I couldn’t help but remember that feeling of panic, like I was trapped, and I just wanted to run away from it all. It really stirred up a lot of fear inside me.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: That sounds really intense. In that moment of panic, what did you notice yourself focusing on or thinking about?

conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: In that moment, all I could think about was just getting out of there, as if escape was my only option. It felt like I was back in that very uncomfortable place, and I couldn’t shake the thought that something really bad could happen again. Everything else just faded away, and it was like I was stuck in that one moment.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: That sounds really overwhelming. Did you notice any physical sensations or changes in your body when you were feeling that way?

conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: Definitely. My heart was pounding like crazy, and I felt a tightness in my chest. I could barely catch my breath, and my palms were all clammy. It was like my body was just reacting, long before my mind could catch up.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: It sounds like your body responded strongly. After experiencing that, how did you feel once things began to calm down?

conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: Once things calmed down a bit, I just felt this deep heaviness inside me, like I was carrying around a weight I couldn’t shake off. I was exhausted, but my mind kept racing with all those old memories. It felt hard to relax, even when the moment had passed.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: That heaviness sounds tough to deal with. During that time, were there any specific memories or thoughts that kept coming to mind?
